title: Floor instants to 15-minute buckets and count them
contract: Floors each instant to the start of its 15-minute window as seen in the given zone, keyed by that window start in epoch seconds (unambiguous across DST; the zone only sets alignment). Keys ascend. Null or empty list gives an empty map; null elements ignored. Null zone throws IllegalArgumentException.
expectedValuesFrom: Epoch seconds computed independently in Python with zoneinfo('America/Denver'), not by running Solution. Denver 2026 transitions: spring-forward 2026-03-08, fall-back 2026-11-01.
notShownInJavadoc: several instants collapsing into one bucket
both sides of the spring-forward gap
the repeated hour on fall-back day
